text:
Type: black and white city skyline canvas
Use: wall decoration; living room, bedroom, home office, above a sofa or desk
Style: modern, contemporary, industrial
Materials: printed canvas, unframed
Colors: white, grey, black
Shape: long panoramic rectangle, dense downtown towers, hillside behind, soft sun flare bokeh circles, slim and horizontal
Feel: urban, bright, dreamy
Goes with: grey or white walls, chrome, black metal, glass; modern or urban loft rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Seattle Sun Flare in Black and White Canvas Print of Seattle, 30" x 10"
product.description: Camera flares become part of the metro landscape in this artistic photo of Seattle. Perhaps taken through the glass window of a plane about to land there, this photo will add a contemporary and cosmopolitan look to your room. A contemporary, sophisticated addition to your room Hand-stretched canvas on wood. 30" x 10" Ready to hang with hardware included. Made to order
